papers_and_supporting_note.scope: For each fixed rational-coefficient continuous actual-PC positive-at-infinity reference on the product of two nonempty finite embedded balanced rational pure graphs with positive real actual weights and rank-one positive relation cones, every bounded continuous real-PA obstacle has a rational-domain PAPC uniformly decreasing regularizable raw envelope with complete contact if and only if at least one factor is unbranched. Every prescribed rational reference on two branched factors admits a nonnegative bounded compact obstacle, unchanged asymptotic reference, exact raw envelope and full integral -8epsilon^2ab<0. Actual saturated lattices, all cycles, ends, full lines and disconnected components retained. Arbitrary-balanced-pair classification and negative extension to all real references remain open.

continued_goal: All original atoms remain open; further research proceeds in small batches.
